Episode Notes:
The Trump administration recently announced new sanctions on Iran as part of what it says is a major new economic offensive. Kerry talks with Alex Vatanka about what's left to sanction, when additional sanctions might have an effect, and why Iran's trade with China plays a crucial role in any effort to further squeeze the economy. They also discuss the United Arab Emirates' move to suspend trade with Iran.
